reason: r35 ran on Eden 2026-10-29 with the installed bytes matching (log work/modern-sharpness-gauge/runs/r35-eden-2026-10-29.txt): the 0% step draws no blue at all and 100% shows the whole blade, and the tester's read of the middle steps is measurement, not opinion. Fitting the four screenshots on that run's own logged cuts (149 and 174) gives 1.4 image px per GUI px and puts the drawn gauge ink at 124..200 px: the 100% box (225) photographed blue up to 200 with 25 px of box past the blade, so the visible blade was 0, 19, 44 and 70 px of a 70 px blade, i.e. steps of 0, 27, 63 and 100%. r36 shortens the track to the measured gauge: BAR_INK_TRACK 70 -> 55 columns, 80 px at the 128 px rect, steps 124, 144, 164 and 204 px, ending past the measured tip with margin. r37 adds the tester's requested test control: a session-only 0-100 slider in the Plugin UI row (no INI, no save data, resets on restart) that sets the clip directly, with the 20 s cycle as the default until it is touched, and src= in the forced line naming which one drove the box. Gates, insertion order, links, the mask's writes and the glow are unchanged from the build the tester ran.
runtime_test: NOT RUN. Pass, on screen: with the slider at 0 nothing of the gauge is drawn, at 25 a quarter of the blade, at 50 half, at 100 the whole blade with the tip uncut, each change visible as you drag; untouched, the bar cycles through those four every 20 seconds. The gauge is present from the quest start and survives area and quest changes, as in the r33-r35 runs. In the log: one forced-ratio line per change with the box, the bar's three rectangles, bar_w=88, feed=128 and src=slider|cycle. Gameplay NOT RUN.

limitations: r4 has no runtime test; its lines, the 320-sample budget and the absence of any drawing change are static results.
r2 was built and never run; r3 was run once on Eden and is recorded.
r14 was run once on Eden and failed as reported: the gauge was clipped away from the insertion and the game crashed at the quest end. Its log is the evidence, and the insertion is removed in r15.

r15 was run once on Eden and drew the gauge normally for 740 seconds with no exception; its facts line printed tree_nodes 3 against 4 objects, and its object-list fields were read from the wrong object (the controller's owner field), which is what r16 fixes.

r16 changes nothing on screen: it reads game memory and logs. No drawing, no gauge change, and no cleanup claim (the root-destructor hook fired zero times in the three sessions that logged it). Its Eden run ended in Eden's own shutdown records (maxwell_3d Critical asserts, ForceStop, host SIGSEGV) with zero guest exceptions.
the game's destructor is assumed to free the map block r17 publishes through the cGUIInstance DTI's MT allocator; that free has not been observed, and r17 frees the old 4-word block itself
The per-weapon tier tables live in RomFS weapon data and are not read in this workspace: no weapon data file is extracted here.
The gauge itself is not part of r4.

r25 has not been run. r24's run drew the gauge from the quest start and lost it at an area change, where a mask kept clipping after its links broke; the disable-on-loss path has no runtime evidence, and a mask inserted into a second area's row has never been observed (r24's log ends 12 s after the transition, gauge HUD absent)
